comment: Dr. Trawick is what you expect a physics professor: He's eccentric, and lectures, fun, and he tries to make things interesting.  He looks like he teaches physics! Only caveath is personality can be a bit self-centered but overall not a deal breaker.

Matt is a rare combo of hilarious, caring, smart, down to earth, (and did I mention hilarious?). Calling the material ‘interesting' wouldn't even begin to cover it. 100% the kind of prof you'd grab a beer with. If everyone took him, there'd be way more physics majors.

If you need a lab, or you are just really interested in Electronics, taking it with Dr. Trawick is about as good as you can get. He is a great lecturer and very knowledgable. Its not a very hard class, just a lot of work. Expect 10-12hrs a week. He's a little quirky but he's chill.

Great class and great professor. He genuinely wants you to succeed and will do what he can to help. He provided most materials, including the textbook. Everything has to stay in the lab, but the lab is accessible almost always.

this class brought my love for physics back. The material was so mind expanding and interesting. Also Matt is hilarious and the lectures are incredibly entertaining. I love his energy - he's the kind of guy you'd want to grab a beer with after class. Take this fys if you like physics!

This class is like knitting a sweater, but you're on fire. It's challenging, yet so fascinating. The class might not be the beginner's jaunt I expected, but it's undeniably mind-expanding (ha!) and genuinely engaging. Matt is helpful outside of class, but if you're not somewhat STEM-inclined, think twice before taking. Lots of hw, labs + a final!

Dr Trawick is a fantastic professor. He does his best to make complex material interesting in his lectures. As a humanities person, I found the class difficult but still manageable. Office hours! There is a lot of homework and the grading can be harsh at times, but MT is understanding and accessible. Very interesting class and great professor.

Dr. Trawick's passion for teaching and knowledge of physics is too great to forgo taking a class with him, though if you're not adjusted to the work load early you'll be in for a semi-unpleasant semester. MT is quite helpful during office hours (compulsory in order to really excel), and classes focus on labs and lectures that supplement homework.
Very helpful in and out of the lab - extremely sharp on troubleshooting and figuring out what you misunderstand. Do get ready for a lot of homework.

Dr. Trawick clearly cares about his students, as long as you care about the class he will help you with whatever you need and you will do well.There was small daily homeworks that just further reinforced what we learned in class, not only that but they were due two classes from the day they were assigned so that you coud ask questions.

Matt is a fantastic,interactive, caring, and hilarious professor, and his FYS lectures were thought provoking, well organized, and incredibly entertaining!  He consistently made himself available outside of class and cared about his students alot.  Be wary of the course difficulty if your not interested or have some background in physics however.

RMP is dumb and I only have 350 characters to work with, so I'll be quick. I took two years of AP Physics and almost flunked both. I took this class to redeem myself. It was brutal, and my math skills going in were rusty. I was inept with getting help, but Matt went out of his way to change that. He not only educated me, but made me more effective.

I would never say a course with Dr. Trawick is easy, but its the kind of challenge that truly makes you enjoy what you are learning.  Dr. Trawick is always honest, pushes you hard, and is always invested in how you do as long as you are also making the effort to improve. Do not isolate yourself!! Seek his help and you will benefit!!

I had Trawick for FYS & e&m. If you have any interest in physics, I'd recommend taking his FYS. The topics help if you want to take the modern physics course, as it covers ~half the content in mp. It is an FYS, so he explains concepts thoroughly & from scratch, but if you are someone who hates math/physics this is probably not for you. Great prof

Taking Electronics with Dr. Trawick made me want to major in Physics! Dr. Trawick actively encourages you to try building circuits and learn from them even if it means you'll blow some things up. I learned best from the lab exercises and HWs, and if I got stuck he was very helpful even outside of class. It was super fun to take this class.

Dr. Trawick is at his absolutely best teaching electronics. The lectures are short and concise, he teaches students with hands-on care, and this class brought my love for physics back. The workload was less than many other physics classes, and he was incredibly responsive outside of class to help us succeed. I tell everyone I know to take it.

Okay. I know you think taking his FYS would be cool. HOWEVER, at least 20 people dropped out after 3 weeks of his teaching. He lets Physics students grade homework for ACCURACY. No kidding because he treated an FYS like a high 300 level Physics course. Unless you know physics, do me a favor, and please DO NOT TAKE this. Ruining GPA 100% guaranteed.

Professor Trawick's FYS was by far the hardest class I've ever taken, DO NOT take this class if you're just curious about the subject. I have never done as bad in a class as this in all my academic career. He treats an FYS like you're taking Physics 400 and assumes you have an extensive background in physics. Get ready for hard daily HW problems to

He is easily the least helpful, most condescending professor there is. He comes off as a nice guy but gives poor feedback on assignments that isn't constructive and is often rude. If you don't already have a clear understanding of physics you will not do well and he will not help you. Unless you want to teach yourself, don't take this class.
Explain every thing very well! Highly recommended! Does have a high expectation on students though so please work hard.

Very tough grader, and is unhelpful when you go to ask for extra help. If you say you are confused about something, he repeats what he already said about it in lecture, and tells you to think about it. He seems very friendly initially, but is actually pretty condescending.

He's a good professor that is fairly helpful but really wants you to work to figure it out on your own. If you try and do the work he's not too bad. It is a lot easier with a physics background but that's true of all physics teacher. Of your choices, I would still pick Trawick if I had to do it over.

Trawick is not the best teacher at Richmond and if you do not have a strong physics and mathematics background I would not recommend taking him, especially at the introductory level.  He does not do much actually teaching in the classroom, and the textbook is confusing, so unless you often meet with him outside of class, it could a long semester.
He is a awesome professor!! I love his energetic. Even i am not a science major his class still makes me feel so good about physics!

Trawick is not the best teacher, but he may be better than a lot of richmond's other physics professors and he definitely tries to help you. he is MUCH better one on one so if you struggle with physics like i did i would definitely recommend that. his quizzes and tests are hard but often he will use at least one problem youve seen before in class

This professor is awful! He is so confusing in class and makes you feel so stupid if you don't know the answer. I went almost every week for extra help and he was never helpful. Take him if you want to fail physics - he curves like crazy, but will still give you 50s on everything.

STAY AWAY FROM HIM AT ALL COSTS! One of the worst profs I have ever had, lectures are extremely convoluted and confusing. He just talks about concepts without telling us at all how to apply them to real problems. Gives a ton of homework problems which he doesn't really help us on anyway. Tests are completely unrelated to any problems seen before
Energetic! You might hate the class because its too hard, but you cant expect a better teacher! btw, hw is sometimes a little bit too much~

He is a fair but tough grader, but he curves like crazy.  However, in an effort to get you to discover the answers rather than just showing you how to do the problem, he can make you more confused. I liked having him in class b/c he was energetic and cared about the students, but I often had to ask a friend who was good in physics for help on hw.

He is terrible! He grades extremely hard, after putting questions on the test that are nothing like the homework problems or the ones done in class. Also, his class discussions do nothing to teaach what is being asked in the homework questions. The only was I managed to get through the class with a B was to attend office hours at least twice a week

He is funny but he is not very good!He is not bad on the grades even though they look bad, but he curves them!Not a big help and extremely disorganized!Nothing like solutions on the homeworks are given!I am not he is actually very good in physics!

IF YOU NEED TO FULFILL YOUR SCIENCE REQUIREMENT TAKE TRAWICK!! The nicest teacher I have ever had. He cares about his students so much and will go far out of his way to help anyone. Very fair grader. If your good at math and science than this class will be a breeze. I didnt do anything all semester. But if you're bad a physics you're bad a physics

He really likes Physics.  You won't get him to just tell you the answers though, which can be frustrating yet in the long run helpful.  There is a LOT of homework, but if you do it, you do well in his class.

Trawick tricks you into thinking he is a cool guy because he lets you call him Matt, but don't be fooled.  The average on tests was usually about a 60.  If you go to office hours he will just make you talk to other students and never really helps you get the answer.  He also is socially awkward and can't carry on a conversation.
nice guy, but is the wrong person to teach you physics if you learn better from a person instead of the book.  Also, dont take him if you arent einstein...or newton...

Matt is a very nice guy. He tries hard to make the class very interesting although since the material can get pretty boring. He practically begs you to come to his office hours. The class is hard but he is fair so you get what you deserve. You will do fine if you work hard on the homework.

He is an awesome teacher. Very enegetic and makes class fun. He knows the material well but more importantly teachs it well. He explains things instead of asking you to memorize them. Very friendly too, overall a great guy.

Really energetic and it's obvious that he knows physics really well, but is pretty hard.  Tries to make class interesting, but because it is 2hrs long it makes it hard.  Really enjoyed the class, but really had to work hard
